abstract: Dysregulation of RNA is closely associated with cancer initiation and promotion. Ribosomal protein S3 (RPS3), as a component of the small subunit 40S of the eukaryotic ribosome, functions as an RNA-binding protein involved in ribosome maturation and the initiation of translation. However, its role in pancreatic cancer biology and its potential as a therapeutic target remain unclear. In this study, we found that RPS3 knockdown strongly suppresses cell proliferation in multiple pancreatic cancer cell lines, SUIT-2, PK-1, and PANC-1 cells, in vitro. In a xenograft model, RPS3 knockdown inhibited tumor growth. Immunocytochemistry revealed a reduction in the proportion of Ki-67-positive pancreatic cancer cells following RPS3 knockdown. Flow cytometry demonstrated that RPS3 knockdown induced G2/M arrest, accompanied by reduced cyclin B1 protein expression. RNA-immunoprecipitation assay revealed RPS3 binds with leucine-rich repeat-containing G-protein coupled receptor 4 (LGR4) mRNA, an upstream regulator in the Wnt/β-catenin signaling. RPS3 knockdown reduced LGR4 protein expression and the nuclear translocation of β-catenin, accompanied by the suppression of c-Myc expression. LGR4 overexpression significantly rescued the suppression of cell proliferation induced by RPS3 knockdown. These findings indicate that RPS3 supports pancreatic cancer cell proliferation through the LGR4/Wnt/β-catenin signaling and highlights RPS3 as a potential therapeutic target in pancreatic cancer.
key_points_ko: 췌장암 세포주(SUIT-2, PK-1, PANC-1) 및 마우스 이식 모델에서 RPS3 발현 억제 시 종양 성장이 크게 억제되었습니다.
RPS3 억제는 췌장암 세포 주기의 G2/M기 정지를 유도하고 Cyclin B1 단백질 발현을 감소시켰습니다.
RPS3는 LGR4 mRNA와 결합하여 LGR4 단백질 발현 및 β-catenin의 핵 내 이동을 조절하는 것을 확인했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 리보솜 단백질 RPS3가 췌장암 증식에 미치는 영향과 기전을 전임상 연구를 통해 규명했습니다. 췌장암 세포주와 마우스 이식 모델에서 RPS3 발현을 억제했을 때 세포 증식과 종양 성장이 유의하게 감소했습니다. RPS3는 LGR4 mRNA와 결합하여 Wnt/β-catenin 신호 전달 경로를 활성화하고 췌장암 세포 주기를 촉진하는 것으로 나타났습니다. 이 결과는 RPS3가 췌장암 치료를 위한 새로운 잠재적 표적이 될 수 있음을 시사합니다.
title: The RNA-binding protein RPS3 accelerates cell cycling via the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway in pancreatic cancer
title_ko: RNA 결합 단백질 RPS3의 Wnt/β-catenin 신호 전달 경로를 통한 췌장암 세포 주기 촉진 작용
